INSERT INTO affiliate.offers_raw
  (source, external_id, hash_dedup, title, url_original, store, brand,
   price_current, price_original, discount_pct, rating, reviews_count, image_url, raw_payload)
VALUES
  ('{{ $json.source }}', '{{ $json.external_id }}', '{{ $json.hash_dedup }}',
   '{{ $json.title }}', '{{ $json.url_original }}', '{{ $json.store }}',
   {{ $json.brand ? `'${$json.brand}'` : 'NULL' }},
   {{ $json.price_current }},
   {{ $json.price_original ?? 'NULL' }},
   {{ $json.discount_pct ?? 'NULL' }},
   {{ $json.rating ?? 'NULL' }},
   {{ $json.reviews_count ?? 'NULL' }},
   {{ $json.image_url ? `'${$json.image_url}'` : 'NULL' }},
   '{{ JSON.stringify($json.raw_payload) }}'::jsonb)
ON CONFLICT (hash_dedup) DO NOTHING;
